facts.text: The estate covers 5,000 acres.
facts.excerpt: A 5,000-acre estate awaits to be discovered

facts.text: The Castiglion del Bosco winery is one of the historic producers of Brunello di Montalcino.
facts.excerpt: One of the historic producers of Brunello di Montalcino

facts.text: The Club at Castiglion del Bosco is a private golf club reserved exclusively for members and guests of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Tee off at The Club, Italy’s only private golf club, reserved exclusively for members and guests of Castiglion del Bosco, A Rosewood Hotel.

facts.text: Ristorante Campo del Drago is a Michelin-starred restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred Ristorante Campo del Drago offers guests a journey through Tuscany's culture in a warm, intimate atmosphere.

facts.text: Osteria La Canonica is a trattoria-style Tuscan restaurant inside the medieval borgo.
facts.excerpt: Savor Tuscan culinary traditions at Osteria La Canonica, a trattoria-style Tuscan restaurant located within the medieval borgo.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar has a Tuscan fireplace and serves light snacks, afternoon tea and nightcaps.
facts.excerpt: An intimate space with a Tuscan fireplace, The Lobby Bar is ideal for a light snack, afternoon tea with fresh treats, or a nightcap.

facts.text: The hotel is set in a 900-year-old borgo.
facts.excerpt: Elegance meets heritage in a 900-year-old borgo

facts.text: The villas were crafted from restored 17th- and 18th-century farmhouses.
facts.excerpt: Crafted from 17th- and 18th-century farmhouses and lovingly restored

facts.text: The villas feature terraces, gardens and heated infinity pools.
facts.excerpt: featuring terraces, gardens and heated infinity pools

facts.text: Villas come with a Land Rover Defender or similar 4x4 vehicle for guests' use during their stay.
facts.excerpt: Villas also come with a Land Rover Defender or similar 4x4 vehicle for guests' use during their stay.

facts.text: Suites combine exposed wooden beams and antique furnishings with the latest technology.
facts.excerpt: Exposed wooden beams and antique furnishings exist alongside the latest technology.

facts.text: Two-Bedroom Suites have two private bedrooms and a shared living area.
facts.excerpt: our Two-Bedroom Suites offer generous space and comfort with two private bedrooms and a shared living area.

facts.text: Villa Sant'Anna is a five-bedroom stone villa with a private pool house and gardens.
facts.excerpt: An enchanting five-bedroom stone villa where dawn-to-dusk views meet exquisite Tuscan stonework, a private pool house, and tranquil gardens.

facts.text: A medieval church stands in the heart of the borgo.
facts.excerpt: The medieval church, in the heart of the borgo

facts.text: A full-day helicopter tour flies over the Val d'Orcia and Val di Chiana.
facts.excerpt: Fly by helicopter over Val d’Orcia and Val di Chiana: a land of great wines and amazing landscapes on this full day tour.

facts.text: Guests can go truffle hunting in the countryside followed by a Brunello di Montalcino tasting.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a beautiful truffle hunting in the countryside followed by a special wine tasting with Brunello di Montalcino.

facts.text: Guests can create a personalized fragrance by exploring olfactory families.
facts.excerpt: Explore different olfactory families and learning how to balance the notes to create a harmonious and personalized fragrance.

facts.text: La Canonica Cooking School offers hands-on cooking classes in traditional Italian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Take part in hands-on cooking classes at La Canonica Cooking School to unlock the secrets of traditional Italian cuisine.

facts.text: Rosewood Explorers is the hotel's children's offering, set among green meadows and tall cypress trees.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by green meadows and tall cypress trees, the fairytale setting is an ideal place for children to play and use their imagination.

facts.text: Guided walks on the Via Francigena, a medieval pilgrimage path, range from 3 to 7 hours.
facts.excerpt: Discover the beauty of the Via Francigena, a medieval pilgrimage path, with walks ranging from 3 to 7 hours.

facts.text: Guided bike tours use road, mountain or vintage bikes built before 1987.
facts.excerpt: Exhilarating guided bike tours with road and mountain bikes or vintage bikes (that is, bicycles built before 1987)

facts.text: Private yoga classes can be held in a guest's villa or in the garden.
facts.excerpt: Attend Yoga classes in Tuscany in the comfort and privacy of your villa or out on the garden

facts.text: The Val d'Orcia Movie Tour visits film locations in Montalcino, Pienza and San Quirico d'Orcia.
facts.excerpt: Discover famous film locations in Montalcino, Pienza, and San Quirico d’Orcia with the Val d’Orcia Movie Tour experience.

facts.text: Each villa has a private heated pool, and some have wood-burning pizza ovens, a home theater or a tennis court.
facts.excerpt: Each one comes with a private heated pool, though some feature wood-burning pizza ovens, a home theater, or tennis court.

facts.text: The estate has a spa and an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: a spa with luscious treatments, and an infinity pool

facts.text: The cooking school teaches Tuscan dishes using organic ingredients from the garden.
facts.excerpt: a cooking school where you can learn to make Tuscan dishes with organic ingredients from the garden

facts.text: The estate has an 18-hole golf course.
facts.excerpt: an 18-hole golf course

facts.text: The hotel is at Localita Castiglion del Bosco in Montalcino, in the province of Siena.
facts.excerpt: Località Castiglion del Bosco, Montalcino, Siena 53024

facts.text: Suites and villas are individually designed in a rustic-chic style, some with four-poster beds.
facts.excerpt: The suites and villas are individually designed in a rustic-chic style, some with four-poster beds, others with block printed textiles.

facts.text: Truffle-hunting excursions and helicopter transfers can be arranged.
facts.excerpt: you can organize truffle-hunting excursions and helicopter transfers
